prompt:
Hey, you're the Analyst agent. I need you to build session analytics for Mission Control Dashboard agent cards.

I interact with agents primarily through voice (Wispr Flow voice-to-text). I want to see metrics on each agent card that tell me things like: how long was I talking, how many prompts did I send, how long was the session, what tools were used most.

Your task: build an Analytics tab on Dashboard agent cards with these metrics:

1. Estimated talk time: prompt word count / 150 wpm (since I use voice-to-text)
2. Total prompts sent + average prompt length
3. Session duration (first prompt to last activity)
4. Tool call breakdown (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Agent, etc.)
5. A mini summary line like: "45 min session, ~20 min talking, 47 prompts, 89 tool calls"

Data sources (all already exist):
- Prompt files: .claude/agent-hub/prompts/{sessionId}.ndjson (hook-captured prompts)
- Transcript files: C:\Users\ephra\.claude\projects\C--Users-ephra-phredomade\{sessionId}.jsonl
- State files: .claude/agent-hub/states/{sessionId}.json (timestamps, tool counts)
- Activity logs: .claude/agent-hub/logs/{sessionId}.ndjson (timestamped tool events)

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first.

Implementation:
- Add GET /api/analytics/:sessionId endpoint to server.js that computes these metrics
- Add an "Analytics" tab to the Dashboard agent card detail view (HTML is embedded in server.js, search for "Summary" and "Prompts" tabs)
- Keep it lightweight: compute on demand, cache briefly
- Design: clean numbers, maybe a small bar chart for tool breakdown. DM Mono for numbers. Color the talk time estimate in green.

DON'T touch dispatch-page.html, campaigns-page.html, findings.json, hook.js, or prompt-hook.js.

Tell me your plan before building.
Yeah you can reset the server. That's fine.

Also can you make some changes? I know this might be a big refactor but by tools the thing I'm interested in is not literal tools but more about agents, sub-agents called, and skills used. Obviously the tools specifically don't matter. I don't care if you read Bash vs Grep. This is the oversight on my part but it would be nice for you to do that accordingly. Maybe yeah that's all you can do for now.

That's crazy. There should be skills and also they should be linked back to it in toolbox and toolbox. It should be because ideally we should be able to map it. Maybe this is another bigger task feature but I need this before I go to sleep.
